headings.strategy: Unbounded for main data points/balances to give a premium crypto aesthetic. Inter for smaller headers.

body.strategy: Inter for all body text for maximal readability on mobile.

colors.strategy: Dark navy base creates depth. Use Cyan for interactive elements and live data (active states), Purple for structural glow/ambient light, and Gold for premium static assets like Creator Balance or Token Supply. Avoid full screen gradients.

layouts.container: w-full max-w-[430px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#050711] overflow-x-hidden flex flex-col relative pb-24 shadow-2xl

cards.style: bg-[#0A0D1C] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]
cards.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-5

layouts.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-[430px] mx-auto h-20 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-around z-50 px-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2

motion.transitions: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease
motion.interactions: Buttons shrink slightly on active (scale-95), cards lift on touch (translate-y-[-2px] shadow-cyan/20)
motion.data_updates: Subtle flash in Cyan when balances update

visual_enhancers.gradients: Text gradients for 'TITAN (TTN)' or Total Supply using bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#FFDF73] bg-clip-text text-transparent
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px inner stroke on all cards to separate them from the deep navy background

wallet_connect.description: Primary action button, thumb-friendly height (min 48px). Deep navy/cyan combination.
wallet_connect.classes: h-14 w-full bg-cyan/10 border border-cyan/30 text-[#00E5FF] rounded-xl font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 transition-all

uid_badge.classes_active: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan/10 border border-cyan/30 text-cyan text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,229,255,0.2)]
uid_badge.classes_inactive: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white/50 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5

balance_card.description: Hero card for Creator Balance / Token Supply.
balance_card.classes: relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0F1326] to-[#0A0D1C] border border-gold/20 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]

pool_grid.description: Grid for Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Community pools. 2 columns to save vertical space on mobile.

pool_card.classes: bg-[#0A0D1C] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-1 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform

bottom_nav_item.description: Touchable zones for navigation. Active state uses Cyan.
bottom_nav_item.classes: flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-16 h-full gap-1.5 text-white/40 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Cyan/Purple accents against Navy pass APCA/WCAG contrast ratios.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements (buttons, nav tabs) MUST be minimum 48x48px.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, balances, and tabs (e.g., data-testid='wallet-connect-btn', data-testid='daily-pool-balance')

background_glow.description: Abstract purple/cyan glow to be used as a heavily blurred (blur-3xl) background overlay at 10-20% opacity fixed behind the top hero section to create depth.

gold_texture.description: Molten gold texture to be used as a mask or very subtle background (mix-blend-overlay opacity-20) on the TTN Token Supply/Creator Balance cards to make them feel premium.

icons.usage: Use strictly 20px-24px icons with a 1.5px to 2px stroke width. For bottom nav: Wallet, LayoutDashboard (Active), Pickaxe, Users, ArrowRightLeft.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align app container; let layout dictate alignment.
Mobile-first strictly. Max width 430px container centered on desktop screens.
Do not use transparent background without backdrop-blur for overlays/nav.
No horizontal scroll on any elements.
Use standard font imports in CSS/HTML for 'Inter' and 'Unbounded'.
instructions_to_main_agent: Construct the frontend to wrap a MobileContainer (max-w-[430px] mx-auto w-full min-h-screen bg-[#050711] text-white relative pb-24 shadow-2xl). Implement the Dashboard view. Add a fixed Bottom Navigation. Build 5 major UI sections: 1) Header (Logo + Wallet Connect + UID/Active Badge), 2) Hero Balances (Creator Balance & Total Supply - 200,000 TTN), 3) Pool Grid (2x2 grid for Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Community), 4) Total Activated Users stat, 5) Bottom Tab Navigation. Use generic mockup numbers but format them beautifully (e.g. $10,000 USDT). Use glowing cyan borders and text for the 'Active' status.
